name: Saved Search
description: Saved searches over meaning and words: notes that keep a query and its results

settings.title: Reranking
settings.description: Services that order the results by relevance, tried in order
settings.details: Services that order the results of a saved search by relevance, tried in order until one answers. With an OpenRouter key, add an OpenRouter connection and choose the model mongodb/rerank-3: it ranks best and answers in a few seconds. Without one, choose the Local reranker, which runs on this machine and takes tens of seconds for each run.

settings.title: Default results
settings.description: Results a search returns when the agent names no limit

settings.title: Passages per condition
settings.description: Passages the index returns for each meaning and words condition when no reranking service is set

settings.title: Passages per condition with reranking
settings.description: Passages the index returns for each meaning and words condition when a reranking service is set

settings.title: Most passages scored
settings.description: Most passages the query is applied to

settings.title: Most folders
settings.description: Most path.startsWith conditions one query joins with OR

settings.title: Passages per result without reranking
settings.description: Passages kept for each result asked for when no reranking service is set

settings.title: Most passages without reranking
settings.description: Most passages kept in one search when no reranking service is set

settings.title: Reranked passages per result
settings.description: Passages sent to the reranking service for each result asked for

settings.title: Most reranked passages
settings.description: Most passages sent to the reranking service in one search

settings.title: Longest reranked text
settings.description: Most bytes of the text of one passage sent to the reranking service

settings.title: Merge gap
settings.description: Largest gap in bytes between passages of one file that join

settings.title: Longest query
settings.description: Most bytes of the text of one query

settings.title: Refresh delay
settings.description: Minutes between runs of a saved search after the index changes
settings.details: Minutes a saved search waits after its last run before an index change runs it again; 0 runs it at once. A change of its query, rerank text or limit runs it at once.

settings.title: Folder of new saved searches
settings.description: Folder an agent creates a saved search in when it names none
settings.details: Folder of the vault, relative to the vault folder, that saved_search_create puts a note in when the agent names no folder; empty is the vault folder.
